# Ian Pontorno — Growth Engineer & Marketing Technologist

Ian Franco Collada Pontorno is a Growth Engineer and Software Developer based in Buenos Aires, Argentina.
He specializes in combining paid media, marketing automation, analytics, and custom software to scale business growth.

## About

Ian bridges the gap between marketing and engineering: he analyzes and optimizes Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns,
builds automation scripts and internal tools with Python, and develops full-stack web applications with Next.js and TypeScript.

Currently working at Fanger Design (Buenos Aires) as Marketing Engineer, focused on paid media and automation.
Previously at Codere (2019–2025) as IT Operations & Automation Specialist, and Ilummi as Front-End Developer.

## Skills

- **Paid Media**: Meta Ads, Google Ads, ROAS optimization, conversion funnels
- **Development**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Python, Node.js
- **Data & Analytics**: Power BI, Excel dashboards, ETL pipelines, data engineering
- **Automation**: Python scripts, REST APIs, workflow automation, ServiceNow, Jira
- **Infrastructure**: AWS, Docker, WordPress, CMS development

## Education

- Bachelor's Degree in Software Engineering — Universidad Nacional de La Matanza (2023–Present)
- Diploma in SAP ABAP Programming — Universidad Tecnológica Nacional (2025–Ongoing)
